hero.h1: Home Remodeling in Hagerstown, Done Right the First Time
hero.subheadline: LMG Remodeling is a family business that handles kitchen and bath remodels, drywall, paint, flooring and the repairs on your list, at prices reviewers call very fair.

image.alt: Basement walls taped, mudded, sanded and primed by LMG, a home remodeling Hagerstown, MD contractor

intro.h2: A family crew for the jobs big and small
paragraphs: LMG Remodeling is a family business for home remodeling Hagerstown homeowners can count on, whether it is a full bathroom or a few faded shutters. The Facebook page sums it up: professional work, reasonably priced and done perfect from the start.

Armando and his crew show up in nearly every review. One family hung their own basement drywall and called LMG to finish it, and LMG did the corner bead, taping, mudding, sanding and priming until it looked perfect. Another customer had sun-faded shutters washed, repainted and rehung more securely than before. All three reviewers mention the same things: clear communication, very fair prices and a home left cleaner than they found it.

items.name: Kitchen and bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Kitchen and bathroom remodels are on the LMG services list, along with the tile, plumbing and electrical work that goes with them. On one master bath and bedroom job the crew started with prep, repairing badly damaged corners so the walls were clean and straight.

image.alt: Project photo needed: finished kitchen or bathroom

items.name: Drywall hanging and finishing
items.blurb: From a single patch to a whole basement. When one family hung their own drywall and it came out less than perfect, LMG did the corner bead, taping, mudding, sanding and priming, and the reviewer says it ended up looking perfect.

image.alt: Basement room with finished and primed white drywall and fluorescent ceiling lights

items.name: Interior and exterior painting
items.blurb: Inside walls and ceilings, plus outside doors, fascia, siding, window and door trim, handrails and concrete stain. LMG also takes down faded shutters, washes and repaints them, then reinstalls them so they look new again.

image.alt: Freshly painted light blue laundry room with white six-panel doors and louvered closet doors

items.name: Flooring and tile
items.blurb: LMG installs LVP, vinyl, hardwood and carpet, and lays tile. Pairing new floors with drywall and paint means one crew can take a room from bare studs to finished, without you lining up three different contractors.

image.alt: Finished basement room with white walls and wood parquet pattern floor

items.name: Doors and windows
items.blurb: Door and window replacement or installation. On one call, LMG replaced a leaking window on the bottom floor of a three level condo: they cut out the rotten wood, replaced it and installed a waterproof membrane before closing it up.

image.alt: Project photo needed: replaced window or door

items.name: Carpentry, repairs and power washing
items.blurb: Smaller jobs get the same care. Reviewers have hired LMG to replace a gable vent and the posts and rails on a split rail fence. The crew also power washes siding, foundations, walkways, porches, decks and patios.

image.alt: Brick townhouse with dark shutters that were cleaned, repainted and reinstalled

items.title: Licensed in Maryland
items.text: LMG Remodeling, LLC is licensed by the Maryland Home Improvement Commission under MHIC #05-152424. The number is printed right on the company logo, so you can check it before any work starts.

items.title: Prices reviewers call fair
items.text: Every review on the Google profile we read says the same thing about price: very fair, fair for the quality and fair price. That is three for three.

items.title: You always know what is happening
items.text: Customers say Armando communicated clearly, replied promptly and kept them informed throughout. One added that his suggestions improved the final result.

items.title: Respect for your home
items.text: One basement customer wrote that the crew was very considerate of their home and left it cleaner than they found it. Another described them as pleasant people with professional conduct.

about.text: LMG Remodeling, LLC is a family business based in Hagerstown, Maryland. In their own words, they do professional work, reasonably priced and done perfect from the start. Armando leads the crew, and he is the name customers mention when they talk about clear communication and smart suggestions. The company is licensed with the Maryland Home Improvement Commission under MHIC #05-152424. The work ranges from kitchen and bathroom remodels to drywall, paint, flooring, tile, doors and windows, and the honest small repairs, like a gable vent or a fence rail, that many contractors pass on.

items.name: Christina B.
items.text:
I had a great experience with LMG Remodeling. Armando and his crew removed my shutters, which had become very faded from years of sun exposure. They carefully took them down, thoroughly washed them, repainted them, and reinstalled them. The shutters now look like new, and they’re actually more secure than they were originally.

Armando was excellent to work with throughout the entire process. He communicated clearly, worked quickly, and made suggestions that really improved the final result. On top of that, his pricing was very fair for the quality of work provided.

I would highly recommend LMG Remodeling to anyone who needs repairs or improvements done around their home. Professional, reliable, and great workmanship.

items.name: Kelly K.
items.text: LMG did a great job finishing the drywall in our basement! We had hung the drywall ourselves and it was less than perfect. Armando and his team did the corner bead, taping, mudding, sanding and priming and made it look perfect! Fair price, good communication and quality results. They were very considerate of our home and left it cleaner than they found it.

items.name: Cari T.
items.text: LMG remodeling replaced a gable vent, as well as fence posts and rails on my split rail fence. They were terrific to work with. Their communication was prompt and they kept me informed throughout. They are pleasant people and their conduct is professional. And their prices were very fair. They will certainly be my go to for projects at home

service_area.text: LMG Remodeling, LLC is based at 823 Woodland Way in Hagerstown, Maryland, and Hagerstown is the town named on its Facebook page. The kitchens, baths, basements, paint jobs and repairs shown here come from homeowners in and around Hagerstown. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your address is covered, call (240) 919-9294 and ask. Small jobs are welcome too.

items.a: Yes. LMG Remodeling, LLC is licensed by the Maryland Home Improvement Commission. The licence number, MHIC #05-152424, is printed on the company logo. You are always welcome to ask for it again when we come out to look at your project.

items.q: Do you do kitchen and bathroom remodels?
items.a: Yes. Kitchen and bathroom remodels are on the LMG services list, together with tile, plumbing, electrical, flooring, drywall and paint. That means one crew can handle most of the trades a remodel needs. Recent posts include prep work on a master bedroom and master bath.

items.q: Will you take on a small job?
items.a: Yes. Reviewers have hired LMG to replace a gable vent, repair a split rail fence and repaint and rehang faded shutters. The crew also does power washing, and a March 2026 post says LMG now offers junk removal and moving services too.

Yes, estimates are free. Call (240) 919-9294 or email lmgremodelingllc@gmail.com with a short description and a few photos of the job. We will set up a time to look at it in person, talk through your options and explain what the work involves.

The Google profile lists LMG as open 24 hours Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday. The fastest way to reach the crew is a phone call to (240) 919-9294 or a message on the LMG Facebook page.

final_cta.h2: Got a project on your list?
final_cta.text: Call LMG Remodeling for a free estimate on your kitchen, bath, basement or repair.
